subject: Law Enforcement Identification Resolution
overview: The committee met to discuss a resolution requiring law enforcement identification and protecting Fourth Amendment rights. The committee voted to keep the paper in committee to gather feedback from local police, legal advocates, and community organizations.

items.title: Resolution to Require Law Enforcement Identification and Protect Fourth Amendment Rights
items.summary: Kept Paper 26-031 in committee to allow sponsors and residents to refine its legal language and seek feedback from the police department, the ACLU, and local community groups.
